messages.author: 5e2e6b528e86ddbc
messages.subject: Shiny in Windows
parts:
Hi All,

I have a shiny application ready that i want to share with some stakeholders across the globe. Now, my problem is that they wouldn't really be able to see my IP Address. Can i host this application in a sharepoint or a webserver (Apache) or something? If you could direct me to how i can do so, that would be amazing.

Thanks,
Madhavan

messages.author: a1bf76ab9a5a2d4b
messages.subject: Re: Shiny in Windows
parts:
That's exactly what shinyapps.io is for
http://www.shinyapps.io/

Or you can get your own shiny server set up, but that's more work and more complicated. Use shinapps if all you need is to show someone else you application.
